node.title: Prize N=256 profile-(3,6) energy-adaptive product windows
node.closure: analytic integer-energy cap plus exact rational certificate
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, integer autocorrelation gives the adaptive conjugate-square cap y_u<=min(144,18+V). An exact product certificate contracts profile-(3,6,S=18) cofactor 256 to V<=46 and cofactor 514 to V<=22. Multiplicity-one emptiness through E=6 and parity-adaptive caps leave nine exact (E,q) chambers for cofactor 514.
node.notes: ROUTE CONTRACTION 2026-07-28: 6273 exact rational comparisons remove m=256 variances 48 through 60 and m=514 variances 24 through 34. Adversarial mod-257 witnesses at E=15,17 falsify stronger geometric premises but lie below the prize interval. Eight profile cofactors remain.
